summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/react-native-svg-transformer@1.0.9 ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled script with rotated string-array obfuscation and a custom-alphabet decoder. This behavior is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (an SVG transformer for React Native). `package.json` declares `"files": ["index.js", "CHANGELOG.md", "README.md"]`, but the published tarball also contains the undeclared `setup.mjs` (11KB) and `math_init.js` (727KB), so the dropper components are outside the declared publish manifest. The library entry point `index.js` is an unmodified metro/svgr transformer, consistent with a trojanized fork where the malicious surface lives entirely in the undeclared dropper pair and fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
